title: Committed on Main
description: An authentication feature was committed directly on main by mistake.
mission: Move the authentication commit onto a feature/* branch and restore main to its original commit. Keep the feature change in Git history.
success: main is restored and the change is safely reachable from a feature branch.

lesson.what_happened: The commit was valid but the main branch pointer included it by mistake.
other_solutions: Cherry-pick onto a feature branch then restore main
lesson.be_careful: Create a reference to the commit before moving main so the work stays reachable.

hints: Inspect the graph and branch pointers with git log and git branch.
Create the feature branch while the mistaken commit is still checked out.
After preserving the commit on feature/auth, switch to main and move main back one commit.

ja.title: Mainへ誤commit
ja.description: authentication featureを誤ってmainへcommitしました。
ja.mission: 変更をfeature/* branchへ移しmainを元のcommitへ戻してください。
ja.success: mainを復元し変更をfeature branchに安全に残しました。
hints: git logとgit branchでpointerを確認します。
誤commitをcheckout中にfeature branchを作ります。
変更を保存後mainへ戻り一つ前へ移動します。

lesson.what_happened: commit自体は正常ですがmain branch pointerが誤って含んでいました。
lesson.be_careful: mainを動かす前にcommitへの参照を作りましょう。
